extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: narrow dutch canal house, 5 m wide, 10 m deep, 12.7 m tall incl. stepped gable and finial, approx. 6.8 x 12 m footprint incl. stoop, bicycle and roof overhang
extras.notes: exterior only (closed building, opaque windows, no interior); front faces -Y; the front door (dutch-canal-house_door_l) is a separate object with its origin on the hinge axis (left side seen from outside), rotate around local Z to open outwards; door frame is dutch-canal-house_frame; brick facade baked separately (dutch-canal-house_facade); no signs, no house number, no text
extras.set: Cozy Homes Around the World Kit

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
